faq.q: How does the spaced-repetition scheduling decide when I see a card again?
faq.a: It uses the SM-2 algorithm. You rate each card Again (0), Hard (3), Good (4) or Easy (5). A rating below 3 resets the card to a 1-day interval; otherwise intervals grow (1 day, 6 days, then multiplied by an ease factor that starts at 2.5 and adjusts with your ratings). Each card shows 'Due for review', 'Next review' date, or 'New card'.

faq.q: What do the four study presets change about a session?
faq.a: Quick revision shows up to 10 due cards; Normal shows up to 25 due cards; Cram shows up to 50 cards whether due or not; Full deck shows everything. 'Due only' presets fall back to the full pool if nothing is scheduled, so you never get an empty session. Your chosen preset is saved for next time.

faq.q: Can I move my cards into Anki or Quizlet?
faq.a: Yes. 'Export CSV (Anki)' writes a Front,Back CSV with a UTF-8 BOM that imports directly into Anki and Quizlet. 'Export all decks (ZIP)' bundles every built-in deck plus your custom cards as separate CSVs with a README. You can also import JSON, or import CSV using a simple front,back-per-line format.

faq.q: What ready-made sets are included and where are my own cards stored?
faq.a: There are ready-made sets across subjects like Ancient/Medieval/Modern History, Indian Polity, Geography, Economy, Science & Technology, English Vocabulary, Computer Knowledge, Banking & Finance, Financial Awareness and International Affairs. Your custom cards are saved under the fcCustom key and your review schedule under fcSR in your browser's local storage — clearing browser data removes them.
